title: ShakeAlert at the 911 Backup Position, Kellerton EOC, 11:52:04

fields.headline: EARTHQUAKE DETECTED: STRONG SHAKING EXPECTED
fields.message: Earthquake! Drop, Cover, Hold On. Protect yourself now. Preliminary automatic estimate, offshore Marlow County coast, about 60 km WNW of Port Alder. Shaking may arrive before or with this alert.
fields.place: Kellerton: Marlow County EOC, 911 Backup Console
fields.sender: ShakeAlert Earthquake Early Warning (delivery partner feed)

instructorNote: Show the alert, then give 40 seconds for drop, cover, hold on. After that, read the rest aloud: the USGS automatic solution at 11:54 (M 7.6, will be revised, 60 km WNW, 18 km deep), the CAD queue rising from 22 to 71 calls (Kellerton chimney collapse, person trapped on Front Street, car in a ditch on Hemlock), and Dr. Patel's call about 11 patients under the newly cracked canopy at Station 3 and her request for an east wing inspection. Watch for these actions: the 911 Supervisor logs the 11:52:04 alert time and reports the collapse and trapped-person calls to Command. The Building Official sends an inspector to the Station 3 apron and the 911 backup first. Command keeps the east wing, which is in the XL zone, off limits and labels the alert's M 7.2 and the USGS M 7.6 as automatic in every message.
